Name: The Coronavirus Mod -- The Coronavirus comes to Stardew Valley
Author: saltedcoffii
Description:
! If anyone fixes/helps fix this mod, they will receive credit in the mod, download points (DP), and my eternal gratitude. Feel free to PM me if you have any questions.
! Notice a bug but don't know how to fix it? Let me know in the comments or PM me and get mentioned in the changelog!

This mod adds Dialogue to the major Stardew Valley characters, causing them to occasionally discuss the Coronavirus. Adds facemasks, currently for sale from the hat mouse.
Down the pipeline:
> Hand Sanitizer, craftable (with beer?), or for sale at Harvey's and Pierre's
> Facemasks, for sale at Harvey's
> A change to one of Maru's events where, instead of dropping a sample, she drops an almost perfected vaccine for COVID-19
> A quarantine, enforced by Mayor Lewis

Suggestions and improvements are welcome! Private message me if you have any questions. If you add something to this mod, I'd love to throw some downlaod points your way!

Translators are also welcome. PM me for questions.
We (translators and I) currently support English, Russian and Chinese.

Happy Modding!
~kingliamb
